title: iran backed houthis reach yemens dhubab bab el mandeb strait sources say 2026 09 11
text:
Sept 11 (Reuters) - The Iran-backed Houthis reached ​the Yemeni ‌town of Dhubab which sits ​directly ​on the Bab el-Mandeb ⁠Strait across ​from the ​island of Perim, two Yemeni government ​sources told ​Reuters on Friday.
Control of ‌Dhubab ⁠and Perim is key to gaining ​hold ​of ⁠the strait, government ​sources told ​Reuters ⁠on Thursday.
